name: AI Valley

Form fields: Name*, Email*, Tool Name*, Tool URL*, optional tool description + short description, category
preparation: A short description (for cards) and a longer description (optional)
Correct category pick (AI Tools, Code Assistant, Startup Tools, etc.)
workflow: Fill the form and choose a category
Submit and wait for manual review — no account needed
watchFor: No stated review SLA or confirmation of acceptance on the form — monitor email
Large undifferentiated directory (1780+ tools) — expect low per-listing traffic
Unclear whether a rejected submission gets any notification
countsAsLive: A dedicated tool entry resolves under the chosen category on aivalley.ai/aitools/ listing pages
unknowns: Whether submissions without a deal or logo still get listed
